reviews.comment: Great professor, he really cares about the topics he is teaching on. Attendance is not mandatory and posts the lectures after class. I recommend going to his lectures, he is very knowledgeable on everything he lectures about and he isn't just reading off the slides. Tests allow for a review sheet and are over the lectures. Class is straightforward.
He's the best!! Take him if you can!! Highly recommend :))

Chupp is the best professor I've ever had. Wait until he is available. Exams worth 60% of course but can use internet, notes & AI and are taken outside of class. 20% of course is quizzes but all are posted at the beginning of semester and can use internet, notes & AI to complete them. Last 20% are Packbacks which are just weekly discussion posts

His class is super easy, he understands pretty much everyone there is just taking it because they have to for core curriculum, so he makes sure the class isn't a headache. You don't even have to go to lecture in person, and he offers extra credit even though it is still so incredibly easy to get an A.
If you are taking 207, get Chupp.
Allows the class to be extremely easy while still informative for those who want to learn about state and local government. 100% take him if possible.

One of my favorite professors at A&M. I enjoyed his lectures and learned a lot of new perspectives because of him. Specifically, voting rights, democracy, and the best form of government. Super chill on grading, easy A.

Easiest prof you can take this class with. Almost no one goes to class, everything is available online. Chupp is an entertaining lecturer and a really cool guy. You'll have like one assignment a week that takes under half an hour and his exams are all easy and online.

The man, the myth, the legend. Honestly this class saved me from all my work this semester. I have a lot of hard classes but I needed credit for government. This class was easy and I didn't have to go in person which saved me time and kept me emotionally stable. If you can take him, TAKE HIM.

Three types of assignments: textbook quizzes, 4 exams, and weekly Packback discussions. All online and open-note (exams included). Opportunities for extra credit. Participation grades for Packback discussions. Drops lowest exam, and takes 20 out of 34 quizzes. Basically as easy as it can get for a college class.
take chupp for 207. If you cant get him, wait until you can.
TAKE CHUPP! HE IS SO AWESOME!
He is such a king.

Take this professor. If you need the POLS credit and Prof. Chupp is an option, take him or wait until you can. Genuinely so caring and grading is lenient. You are graded based on 3 of 4 tests, 20 of 28 quizzes, and 10 of 16 discussion posts. That means you can be done with 3-4 weeks left in the semester. Assignments are dropped, so don't worry.
TAKE HIM! Gave us the option the first day of class if we wanted to take the class as virtual. Super easy no due dates on anything excpt exams and packbacks. Super easy.
Every lecture and assignment (including exams, quizzes, homework) was available online and very easy
Easiest class ever.

TAKE HIM IF YOU CAN. Chupp makes this class so easy I would forget I even had it on my schedule. The class is basically online and everything is open note (even the tests), so it's a guaranteed A as long as you do the assignments. If you're interested in the class material, he's also a great lecturer with a lot of passion for what he teaches.

Practically impossible NOT to get an A in this class. Chupp is an amazing professor/THE BEST for this class! Every assignment is open internet and extra credit is given for attending review sessions. I was done with this class BEFORE thanksgiving break AND i have a 103. He even only takes around 75% of the highest assignments in a certain category.

If you can, absolutely take Chupp. With the way the class is designed (open internet for everything), it is a guaranteed A unless you purposely try not to pass. Also, since only 3/4 exams are required, I was able to end off with a 99 for the course before Thanksgiving break, giving me plenty of prep time for other finals.

This class was insanely easy and you never HAVE to go to class, but when I did it was always interesting and insightful. He is very knowledgable of government, and likes to foster all kinds of learning. The class ended before Thanksgiving for me, so make sure to get good grades so you dont have to take the final.

Insanely easy class, attendance is not mandatory and all the work can be done without going to class. Very clear on the grading, and drops the lowest exam out of 4 exams. Exams were really easy because they were open note and lectures are posted online. Class basically ends by thanksgiving break.

Chupp is one of the freest professors you can ever have. So many open note and open internet assignments (quizzes AND exams!) that you MUST take him if possible! If you don't care for the course material, take this class. It is ZERO effort for a free A, as long as you do the assignments.
Greatest professor ever, take if you want to pass while also learning the material.
Chupp is the actual goat
Professor Chupp is so good! I cannot recommend him enough!
Get his class if you can. I never went. Easiest A ever.

If you're planning on taking POLS207 you should take it with Prof Chupp. The course is basically all online, and the way the work is setup you'll only have to do like 75% of all the assignments to get an A. You also don't have to take the final if you're okay with your exams1-3. And everything is open book, notes, lectures, internet, etc.

The GOAT. It's basically all online, he has weekly packback discussions (take like 10 minutes), gives 4 easy 50 question true/false exams which are all online and unproctored. He takes your best 20 quiz grades (out of 30), and that's essentially the whole class. If you want the easiest A that you'll ever receive in college, TAKE CHUPP.

Very easy class and great prof. Class is essentially an online course and you never really have to step foot into the lecture hall. Tests are open everything but are based on his arguments/interpretations made in class. Personally, I'd recommend going into class or genuinely watching the videos so you have a general idea of his arguments.
HE IS SO GREAT

TAKE HIM! this is literally an online class (quizzes and exams online, open book/ internet). Attendance is not mandatory. If you go to class one day before exams he gives you one extra point added to your final grade. I literally only went the first day of classes and the days he gave extra credit and finished the class with a 98.

Very chill prof who made the class an easy A. Doesn't require attendance for this lectures but the way he teaches makes you want to go anyways. Very engaging class discussions. Honestly a great prof and good person too.

Don't get any other prof, hold out until you can get Chupp. His class is one of the easiest As you could get. Online homework, quizzes and exams, open note, open book, open internet. You don't even have to step foot in his class because everything's online. He gives entire points to your grade for extra credit. It doesn't get any better than this.

Best Prof for POLS 207. Assignments were easy to complete and only took 30 minutes to do. Exams were super simple and if you studied the night before you will get an easy A. Would highly recommend putting off 207 if you can until you get Chupp if you want to make your life easier.

THE 🐐!!! Attendance isn't mandatory, he treats it as an online class. All exams are take home and open internet. He drops the lowest including final so after the first 3 if they are all A's you don't have to take the final. Weekly pack backs which are super easy. In my opinion if you can't get Chupp try to wait and take Pols 207 later with him.

He's the goat. This is probably the easiest class I've ever taken. Assignments are extremely easy since everything is open note including exams. And on top of this he drops assignments so you don't even have to do all of them. I've went to lecture less than 5 times and still got an A+. 1000% recommend

Professor Chupp was one of the best profs I've had here at A&M. As a BIMS major, this class was one that I didn't have to stress too much about. Exams are open notes, open internet, etc and straightforward. Loved being in his class and would reccomend him to anyone.
What a guy. He cares about his class and the lectures, but makes it super easy. I never went to his class. Everything is open notes.
He is the ONLY prof you want to take if you want a guaranteed A with little to no effort put in.

Everything is online. 95% of the class can be found on quizlet. There are weekly Packback discussion posts and responses but those are easy. If you just do two quizzes, one post, and two responses a week it takes about an hour if you're fast and you won't need to take the final test. Just wait to take him until I register for 206 with him first.

Chupp gives a good class experience whether you choose to attend lectures or not, open notes/internet everything and free class, but if you choose to invest in it you will be introduced to many diverse ways of thinking and viewing government

The whole class was really chill. Taking this course with professor Chupp didn't add any sort of stress as all exams were open note/internet and there were lots of dropped grades. Highly recommend getting him as your professor!

LOVE CHUPP. I would take him a million times over again. Test heavy, but open note. I took this class completely online as he recommended, and it was an easy A. Be prepared for packbacks and textbook quizzes.

TAKE HIM. This was the easiest class I've ever taken at A&M. Its practically an online class because he posts every lecture on Canvas, so you never have to go to class. The 4 exams and weekly quizzes are open internet, open note, and open textbook. He is fun to learn from and super low maintenance.

Easiest class ever. Takes top 20/30 quizzes, top 10/16 packbacks, and top 3/4 exams. Everything is open note. Treats class like an online class so he'll Post every lecture. He's passionate about what he teaches. If you need this class take Chupp!

As a freshman in general engineering, Prof Chupp made POLS 207 a simple class I didn't need to stress over. Assignment-wise, he takes the top 10/16 Packback posts, top 20/30 quizzes, and top 3 exams (optional final). He calls this a "glorified online class", meaning everything is open internet and open lecture/slides (which he posts). Chill prof!

THE BEST PROFESSOR EVER OMG!! he is a king bless him . Literally all you have to do is quizzes ,packbacks, and tests that he allows you to use the internet for. On top of that he offers extra credit. Easiest A ever.
Chupp is an amazing prof who wants to make the class as easy as possible for students. Final exam is optional and all his exams are true/false. Easy homeworks and readings every week and nice guy.

I waited until open registration to get into Chupp's class and I've had zero regrets! He is a wonderful professor who truly cares so much about government. It was a super easy class as he has a clear grading criteria and gives lots of extra credit prior to exams. When I say take his class, trust me you want to TAKE HIS CLASS!!!

If you can, TAKE HIM!!! He is by far the best professor for POLS 207. He has a very clear grading criteria, and the courseload is not very demanding or difficult. His lectures are also engaging and fun to go to as well.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: With Chupp just know this class is a free A with at most 20 minutes per week. Lectures are never mandatory, so this class was basically an online class for me. If you do decide to go, you can tell he's an amazing lecturer. Do anything you can to take him, especially if you're in engineering and want to focus on physics and math classes.

I have not seen this man once this semester, but I assure you that the one time I do, I wish to shake his hand for making this course the most accessible and lightweight required class I will ever take here at Texas A&M.

TAKE HIM! One weekly discussion, and quiz, sometimes two. All online- even tests. Holds exam reviews the week of tests and it adds one point to overall grade! Everything is online and unproctored, so you don't need to go to class. Super nice guy.

I haven't finished the course yet, but I know I will end with an A! I have the 8am lecture but the class is all online and the test are completely open note. I show up to lectures just for a place to sit and study, but he also has exam reviews which add a bonus point to your final grade. I HIGHLY recommend taking Chupp!

Chupp was a great professor. Attendance was not required whatsoever so it allowed me to focus on more difficult courses while taking POLS 207. All exams and quizzes are online and it's quite easy to find corresponding quizlets for the majority of them.

Best professor for this class. He records all lectures and basically lets you take the class completely online. The tests are crazy easy, I never studied and didn't make lower than a 96. You only need to attend and take notes on the test review lecture. He also was just an interesting guy, I loved listening to him talk about Passbacks.

DON'T TAKE ANYONE APART FROM CHUPP. As an engineering major I wanted to focus on my core classes, I could not imagine having to put a significant amount of effort into my non-major courses in order to get an A. With Chupp, I was able to do just that. If you want to make your life easier and have the opportunity to take Chupp, do it!!!

The only lecture I went to was the first one so I can't say I know Dr. Chupp on a personal level. However, I can attest to the ease. I got an A with minimum effort despite my absence. Like others have said, all of the content for this class is open everything so if you're good enough at googling and using AI, you should be perfectly fine.

If you have Dr. Chupp, consider yourself blessed. He's an incredibly cool guy and getting an A in his class is incredibly easy. Lectures are not mandatory but are interesting. By far the best Pols professor out there.

BEST PROF FOR POLS!! Class consists of 4 tests, and the lowest one gets dropped. If you like you're first 3 exams and other assignment grades, you can be done with the class by mid-November! He also accommodates for students who would rather take the class fully online. Can't say enough great things about Prof. Chupp!!
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr.Chupp truly cares for his students, and it shows. The class consists of many opportunities to earn extra credit for tests and overall grade points to your final grade. Truly a very easy class to get an A+ in if you try. It's a required class so take CHUPP!

One of the easiest classes I've ever taken - all material is open note, open textbook, open lecture, open internet, even exams. Homework is no issue, just weekly readings and packback assignments. Chupp himself is a pretty nice lecturer, and with how chill the class is participation is encouraged and lectures teach content well.

Truly one of the greatest professors I've ever had. The class is very easy because it is all online, open-note, plenty of time to complete. Because of that, you can spend much more time enjoying and actually learning from him in the lectures and from the textbook. He also has some unique insights on politics. Would 100% recommend every time.
Awesome professor. All quizzes and exams can be taken online at any time. As long as you do your packbacks and complete all the assignments the class is an easy A.

I went to class 3 times this semester and got an A+ in the class. The assignments are easy and not overwhelming at all. Would 100% take him again - this class is an easy A if you turn in your work. I made this an honors contracted class and he was very helpful with that as well!
Professor Chupp knows everyone takes his class for the required university curriculum, and he makes it as easy as humanly possible to get an A.
If you don't get an A in the class its completely your fault. He makes it as easy as possible. Can be taken like an online class. Everthing is always open note.

Literally one of the best professors here. Honestly I think it's impossible to get less than an A in this class. Attendance is not mandatory, I had him for 8 am, only went on the first day. He records all the lectures and records exam reviews.

I love Chupp! He's a great professor and his online class wasn't hard at all.  There are so many grade opportunities and you only need to do about 75% of the material assigned so if you miss a few things you'll be ok.  I cannot recommend him enough if you can take Chupp for POLS

Dr. Chupp's class was such an easy A. Lots of assignments get dropped and it's almost impossible to not get a good grade. His tests were verbatim his lectures, so make sure you take good notes for the exam. Open note/internet quizzes and exams that were not that difficult (I suck at history).

Chupp is the best option for the POLS credit, all the quizzes and homeworks were easy, just don't wait until the last second to do them. The exams could sometimes be annoying just because he based the questions on his interpretation.
Free A. Enough said. Don't take this class with any other professor.

Professor Chupp is by far my favorite professor. I took him as an online class and it was so easy to get an A. The tests were kind of tricky sometimes, but if you go back and watch the lecture recordings he almost verbatim says the answer. Will be taking him for all future pols credits.

This class was a breeze. He understands that most people take this class for a required credit. He makes it painless to get a good grade. I took it in person but he posted all the lectures online. The exams were not difficult (but not easy) but he did offer extra credit just for attending the review sessions. YOU WANT TO TAKE HIS CLASS.

Out of all the professor options, he's definitely the best one for this course. Although he does his lectures in-person, he also posts them online, so you don't even have to show up to class if you don't want to. There's also several extra credit opportunities in his class, and he even drops the lowest exam grade at the end.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Take this professor at all cost. Such an easy class, easiest class I have taken thus far.

Best professor I have had! He wants you to succeed. Only went to class two times, he wants you to treat it like an online course. Watch the lectures and you will do fine. If you don't want to, literally just do the reviews and you will do good on exams (open note, open internet, 3hrs). Weekly pack back and reading quizzes are easy. TAKE HIM!!

He lets you use open notes and open internet on exams, which makes it 100x less stressful. He doesn't require attendance and uploads all his lectures. I thought I'd still go, but I ended up doing the course and reading the textbook at home, rather than attend the lectures. I appreciate him making the class lenient and easy to do from home.

Dr. Chupp made POLS 207 an interesting class to take. The assignments are just weekly packbacks and quizzes which are quite simple and don't take up a lot of time. The exams were in an online format with 50 true or false questions which were open notes. However, most of the exam questions are answered in the exam reviews.

His assignments don't take too long at all and are reasonable for each week. If you were happy with your grade after Exam 3 and finished the required number of quizzes (you don't need to do all of them for full credit), then every assignment/the final was optional. Exams were true/false questions and online/open note, and he records lectures.

Prof Chupp is by far the best prof I have had, his attendance isn't mandatory, all the lectures are recorded into canvas. His quizzes and tests are open book, open note, open lecture, open internet, he just asks you don't use another student for help. I 100% will always recommend prof chupp to anyone taking pols!

If you're taking a lot of credit hours and need at least one easy class, take professor Chupp. He records his lectures, and his assignments are not time-consuming. He also takes only a portion of every type of assignment, so if you miss one it's fine. His quizzes and exams are open everything (use the slides he posts and go to reviews).

This professor is amazing, we were an in person lecture class but he made it incredibly easy to do everything from home and virtually. He had large gaps in between assignments and an extremely clear syllabus. I would take any course he teaches as he is a great lecturer as well.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Super easy A. Everything is posted online, including recordings of the lectures. He's super flexible with grades and makes it super clear what the bare minimum you need to do for an A is. All exams and quizzes are open note and open internet. Have to purchase textbooks, but you don't really need to read them.
the goat
Professor Chupp is amazing. If you are looking for a fun and easy way to get your POLS 207 credit, he is the best possible teacher to take.
BEST PROF EVER. EVERY OTHER PROF<

Prfoessor Chepp was HIM. He was a very great gut and had interesting lectures. I was very engaged with how the government functions and learned a lot more than I thought I would. The class was not that hard and the exams were online. JESSE CHUPP IS THE BEST POLS PROF. I finished with a 104.
Bro is the goat. I love me some Chupp. He is my role model I love chupp
Very little homework and easy online tests. He wants you to pass, and it shouldn't be any struggle to.

His lectures are interesting & he records them. Roughly a 1/3 of ur Packbacks & quizzes are dropped. Exams are open-note, open-lecture, true-false, and you have like 3 hours to do it. They are online & u can finish them in ur free time. One of the 4 exams is dropped. I legit finish my class work by April and just focused on other classes.
best class ever. TAKE FROM CHUPP!!!! drops exams and homework grades, is a funny guy, and this was finally a POLS class that didn't feel like eating gravel. easy, not-stressworthy, chill. perfect
His class is very easy. However as a prof hes okay. He'll definitely help you if you talk to him and is pretty laid back. He doesn't seem to care too much about the class itself.
amazing prof. understands the course is required and is chill. recorded lectures, easy quizzes, exams the same as exam review. easy A

Easy class, great prof! He is a great lecturer! He offers a lot of extra credit and his exams are open-note. You are graded by exams, weekly packbacks, and quizzes. Everything was pretty easy and straight-forward. If you stay on top of your work you should do amazing!

Dr. Chupp's lectures are amazing, and keep your attention. Luckily, this leads to you actually learning, which translates perfectly to the exams, which are all online. All the homework, textbooks, quizzes, and participation are all online as well. There's no due dates, meaning you can knock them all out early. Amazing teacher, would take again.
Simply the easiest A you will ever receive in your college career. Take if at all possible. Free 4.0 boost.

i was done w the class like 1.5-2 months before the semester ended bc i completed everything he'd use for ur final grade (top 15 out of 20 online quizzes that are on quizlet so easy af, top 10 packbacks, 4 ONLINE OPENNOTE OPEN INTERNET exams but uses the highest 3 so i didn't even take the final)
Chupp was so awesome! I had a really bad experience in POLS 206, but I liked this class. Very easy going and chill! Would definitely recommend!

16 weekly packbacks, only top 10 grades are counted, easy to get 100 on all of them, and 6 other opportunities for 100. Easy quizzes, easy exams. Extra credit review during lectures before each exam. Attendance is not mandatory.

Very interesting and informative professor. Attendance was not required and exams were easily if you have read through the slides. There is a large amount of participation because of the weekly quizzes and packbacks.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Chupp is one of the greatest professors I've ever had. As long as you do the packbacks and quizzes you should be good. Attendance isn't mandatory and the reviews for exams basically give you most of the answers.
The EASIEST class you will ever take in your college career- practically a free A.

If you are taking a POLS class, I could not recommend him enough! If you really want to learn about political science, maybe pick a different professor. He wants everybody to ace this class and wants by the end of the semester for his classroom to be empty. Chupp knows that POLS is a required course and wants to make your load as light as possible.

Simply, the perfect POLS professor. He understands that most of his students have other class commitments, and makes it very accessible to get an A. For the tests, all you need to do is watch the review video, and you will learn the unit and do well on the test pretty easily. He doesn't give a ton of busy work and is overall a very nice guy.

Super great guy! Absolutely take Chupp if you can, especially if you have a lot of hours and want to knock out an easy POLS class. He gives 1 bonus point to your final course grade if you go to his review session before tests which is really awesome. Tests are open note/internet and all his answers are in his slides, just read them carefully.

All lectures are posted online, almost 30% of lowest assignment grades are dropped alongside one test, and tests are online over the duration of the weekend. Review days answer nearly half of the test questions. Easy filler class to take. Chupp is the best!!

Such a great professor! Weekly quizzes and four exams (though if you are satisfied with your grade after the third exam you do not have to take the fourth). He allows textbook/internet access for all quizzes & exams. No attendance, but he's very knowledgeable and lectures are very interesting. Such a kind and intelligent prof! Highly recommend!!
W professor, truly a great person and class is easy. I stand with Dr. Chupp. Awesome human being.

This is the best teacher for POLS 207. There are four exams, and all the exam questions are True/False. Plus they're open-note and open-internet. Same goes for the weekly quizzes. You don't have to go to lecture, but he's a great speaker, so I would recommend it. He's a very chill guy that is fun to listen to.

Professor Chupp was great! The quizzes were straight from the textbook and the homework for this class was not too time-consuming. His tests were all online, true/false, and not too hard if you attend the review days.

Very organized in terms of how the class is ran, no surprise assignments randomly showing up in Canvas. Quizzes are all about the textbook and tests are solely based on the lectures. The tests are all true/false questions and his interpretations takes precedence over the textbook(they might conflict).

Professor Chupp cares about his students learning the material much more than grading them for it. He gave awesome and fun lectures. All of his tests were open note, open internet, and take home tests. Overall great proff who actually cares.
This is the man all teachers should strive to be like. You cannot out-do Chupp. Also, you don't even need to buy any of the textbooks.

Dr. Chupp is a great professor! This class consisted of weekly Packbacks, lectures, and quizzes with 4 exams. Exams are true or false and open note. This class was very organized and doable as long as you keep up with the assignments. Highly recommend Dr. Chupp, he was a great lecturer and I learned a lot from this course!
Chupp is awesome. He really knows what he is talking about and the class is easy. He understands everyone has to take POLS 207, so he does not want to see you fail. Highly recommend!

Anyone who chats disrespect on Chupp's name is wrong. This class is so easy, read the chapters for the quizzes, copy the slides for the exams. There are some inconsistencies on his exams but I emailed him with evidence and got them changed. I didn't do perfectly on the exams, but the packbacks and quizzes are light so its not that deep.

This was by far the easiest A that I have taken during the Fall of 2022 semester. He uploads the lectures online so you don't even have to go to class. However, you do need to pay attention to what he says in class- that's what he bases the tests on. I never read the book and did just fine, but read it. Do your packbacks and weekly quizzes.

Online course was very easy as long as you do all the assignments. Everything is open note so you can get by without reading the textbook on quizzes and exams are based off lecture. However if you want a straight shot A you should read up on the textbook so you'll have an easier time with quizzes. Overall the class was very adequate for pols!
This guys a G. Take him if you can.

Professor Chupp is one of the best professors I've ever had. I was concerned in taking a political science class because I've had over-opinionated teachers and professors in the past whose own ideas took away from the class, but Chupp was unbiased, cared about us learning, and fostered an environment where we could learn and share ideas freely.

Pretty easy class, Only counts the top 10 assignments and 10 quizzes. You also get your lowest exam grade essentially dropped. The exams are the only confusing thing especially the first one because the exam is entirely based off of his recorded lectures and slides.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Professor Chupp is AMAZING. We had two assignments per week, one being a participation grade for Packback. The exams are identical to the review he holds before every exam. If you attend the review there is no way you can fail. He loves to see his students succeed, gives out a lot of hints during lecture, and bonus points for attending the review.

He is very passionate about the subject he teaches, and wants you to succeed! He dropped one low test grade, plus a good amount of Packback grades (discussion posts) and quiz grades. Exams are in true/false format and are open-note. Just take good notes during his lectures. He also gave lots of extra credit. He is very approachable and friendly.

TAKE HIM!TAKE HIM! I cannot emphasize that enough. Weekly packbacks and quizzes. Packpacks are easy and the quizzes are easy to make a 100  since the answers are straight from the book. Exams are easy they are open notes and the questions were made from his videos. Love this man. He is a caring man that loves his students and job. 11/10

I hate POLS but he made the class better. His exams are only true or false so you have to know whats going on, but he also does the best reviews so as long as you go to the review days you should get a good grade on the exams.

I took completely online pols 206 taught by professor Chupp. The class was very straight forward with a very scheduled weekly routine. Overall I probably spent less than a couple hours a week total with work for this class as the lectures are somewhat short, but enough to get a good grade on the tests. I will be taking Mr. Chupp again for 207.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Chupp was a great professor, he responds to emails quickly, its graded by participation, weekly quizzes that are open note, and 3 exams ( the highest of four). His lectures are to the point and he doesnt ramble about stuff that wont be tested. Exams are open note and internet and your given like 3 hours to take the exam. Great Prof!

ONLY take Chupp for any POLS classes you have to do. Class is extremely low effort and gives insane extra credit. Tests are on canvas take home: open note, open internet, etc. Shows answers to see what you got wrong right after submission. Do not buy textbooks for this class. Reading can be found free online.

DO NOT BUY THE TEXTBOOKS! You can use quizlet and get all of the same info for the quizzes. All assignments are open note, internet, etc. Very good prof and if you go to the review sessions, you do very well on the tests (which are take home btw).

GOAT. That is all I can say about this man. He is simply the goat. Do not take anyone else. If you can take Chupp and be welcomed to the land of stress relief. This man understands engineers cannot pour hours into a core class. That is why he is the goat.

Professor Chupp does an excellent job creating clear connections between concepts throughout the course, emphasizing them heavily throughout the semester. It's important to attend lectures and pay attention to his commentary, but if you miss one or two you can always catch up from the slides. I'd recommend him in a heartbeat!

Absolutely loved having him for POLS 207! Easy workload, one 10 q quiz and one packback per week (only the top 10 grades for both are taken) and 4 exams (lowest one dropped). Exams are 50 T/F questions online on canvas, but if you attend the review sessions the week of, he goes over the material you need to know, and everything is open note

This class is an easy A if you put in the effort. Weekly packbacks and quizzes, and he takes the top 10 from each and drops the rest.
